## Logging

[Pino](https://getpino.io) — the default choice in the "logging" dimension (Winston is the alternative; skip both for a bare, dependency-free console logger). `utils/logger.js` exports `logger.info/warn/error/fatal/debug`, used the same way throughout this project regardless of which logging library you picked. `pino-http` (wired into `app.js`) attaches a request-scoped `req.log` and logs one line per request. Pretty, colorized output in development; plain structured JSON in production — what log aggregators (Datadog, CloudWatch, ...) actually want to ingest.
